{{EventEnd|date=26th of January 2020}} {{For|[[Krampus' Revenge Event]]}} {{EventInfobox |title1 = Christmas 2019 Event |image1 = Christmas2019Thumb.jpg |dates = 24 December 2019 – 26 January 2020 |previous_event = [[Halloween 2019 Event|Halloween 2019]] |next_event = [[Spring 2020 Event|Spring 2020]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Christmas 2019 Event''', also frequently called the '''Winter 2019 Event''', was the fourth event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. This event brought two new event towers, the [[Frost Blaster]] and the [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] (later renamed to the [[Archer]]). The event also introduced the [[Event Store]], new enemies (of which some were remade enemies that were previously removed), a new crate and a new map. This event also introduced the [[Rewards]] tab in the lobby. This event started on the 24th of December 2019 (Christmas Eve) and ended on the 26th of January 2020. Additionally, this event contained a smaller event ('''New Years 2020''') which started on the 1st of January 2020 and ended at the same time as this event. However, this was considered part of this event as there was no exclusive map or enemies. You could buy gifts in this event.
